visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women with long dark hair are positioned in a luxurious, bright indoor hallway with polished marble floors and arched entranceways. They both wear matching, sleeveless, one-shoulder gold sequined gowns that shimmer under the warm indoor lighting. The woman in the foreground holds a wooden violin and waves her left hand toward the camera with a bright smile, while the woman behind her holds a silver flute to her lips in a playing posture. (2) The scene transitions as the two women swap spatial positions through a quick movement. Now, the flutist stands in the foreground, waving a hand and smiling broadly at the viewer while holding her flute vertically. Behind her, the violinist has moved to the background and begins an energetic performance, moving her bow across the strings with wide, rhythmic arm motions while swaying her body. (3) The violinist in the background performs a full 360-degree spin while continuing to play her instrument, causing her long hair and the hem of her dress to flare out. Cartoon-style white sparkle graphics briefly appear above her head to emphasize the movement. The flutist remains in the foreground, maintaining her smiling pose and waving toward the camera as the video concludes.
